hardwareCatalog.title: AI Rackscale Solution / Helios AI Rackscale Solution / AI Infrastructure Targets Inference
hardwareCatalog.subject: AMD

specificationFacts.source_quote: AMD has introduced the Helios AI Rackscale Solution, its latest AI infrastructure platform built around the AMD Instinct MI455X GPUs and 6th Gen AMD EPYC “Venice” processors, targeting hyperscale AI inference, enterprise AI and high-performance computing (HPC).
To simplify AI software development, the company has also introduced ROCm.ai, an AI-assisted GPU programming platform that integrates with coding tools such as Claude, Codex and Cursor.

supplyFacts.source_quote: 此次合作将使 AMD 自 2027 年起获得 Core Scientific 超过 500 兆瓦的 AI 数据中心容量，其客户可利用这些设施部署人工智能系统。

specificationFacts.source_quote: At Advancing AI 2026, AMD launches 6th Gen AMD EPYC™ CPUs, AMD Instinct™ MI400 Series GPUs, AMD Helios™ AI rackscale solutions, AMD Ryzen™ AI Embedded X100 processors and the AMD Kria™ AI SOM and Robotics Developer Platform.
